snippet.title: DEORUM - Announcement Trailer (Dark Fantasy Horror Dungeon Crawler)
snippet.description:
Play the demo now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4426430/DEORUM_Demo/

DEORUM is a dark fantasy horror dungeon crawler. Descend into the forsaken dungeon and fight the horrors in the dark. Gather occult materials, craft nightmarish coins, and settle your debt to the cosmic powers. Obey the Divine Festival.
